blocks.text: 几周前，我们推出了 Muse Wonder 系列，这是我们迄今为止能力最强的模型，在个人与专业智能体任务上实现了业界领先的表现。今天，我们推出基于 Muse Wonder 训练的现有模型专用版本，并逐步向 Muse 和 Meta AI 的用户开放。

blocks.text: 将前沿能力带给 Muse 和 Meta AI

inlines.text: 将前沿能力带给 Muse 和 Meta AI

blocks.text: Muse Wonder 的设计目标，是在工作和日常生活中处理复杂任务时具备前沿能力。我们也借助它改进了 Muse 和 Meta AI 背后的模型，让更多人用上其中部分能力。

blocks.text: 在 Muse Wonder 中，我们引入了主动记忆（Active Memory）和主动聚焦（Active Focus）。现在，我们把这两项能力带到了 Muse 和 Meta AI 的专用模型中。

inlines.text: 在 Muse Wonder 中，我们引入了主动记忆（Active Memory）和主动聚焦（Active Focus）。现在，我们把这两项能力带到了 Muse 和 Meta AI 的专用模型中。

blocks.text: 主动记忆让 Muse 和 Meta AI 能记住重要信息，并识别出早先的信息何时变得相关，从而更容易在你过去的对话基础上继续推进。我们训练模型分辨哪些信息是临时的、哪些是长期的，跨时间进行推理，并区分哪些信息仍然相关、哪些已经过时。例如，Muse 中改进后的模型在遗忘关键信息方面减少了 2.4 倍，而这些信息对帮助你实现目标至关重要。

blocks.text: 主动聚焦让 Muse 即使遇到意外挑战，也能继续朝着目标推进。我们针对现实世界中各种典型的瓶颈对模型进行了训练，使它们能更努力尝试、从挫折中恢复，或代你寻找替代方案。在 Muse 中，我们的模型在完成那些会出现意外问题的日常任务时，表现提升了 67%。

inlines.text: 主动聚焦让 Muse 即使遇到意外挑战，也能继续朝着目标推进。我们针对现实世界中各种典型的瓶颈对模型进行了训练，使它们能更努力尝试、从挫折中恢复，或代你寻找替代方案。在 Muse 中，我们的模型在完成那些会出现意外问题的日常任务时，表现提升了 67%。

blocks.text: 我们还开发了专用模型，让它们发挥 Muse Wonder 在 Muse 尤为看重的一些行为上的表现。例如，它们学会了成为出色的多任务处理者，知道何时独立推进你的目标，何时与你实时协作。它们还能在任务执行过程中更好地适应你的引导和澄清，而不会陷入混乱。

blocks.text: 在 Meta AI 中，同样的改进让它成为更好的思考伙伴和协作者。它能把复杂问题拆解成清晰的步骤，提出更精准的追问，并在对话中途你改变方向时跟上节奏。

blocks.text: A few weeks ago, we introduced the Muse Wonder series, our most capable models to date, delivering state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks. Today, we’re introducing specialized versions of our existing models, trained using Muse Wonder, and rolling them out to people who use Muse and Meta AI.

blocks.text: We designed Muse Wonder to have frontier capabilities for complex tasks at work and in everyday life. We’ve also used it to improve the models behind Muse and Meta AI, bringing some of those capabilities to even more people.

blocks.text: With Muse Wonder, we introduced Active Memory and Active Focus. We’re bringing both of these to our specialized models in Muse and Meta AI.

inlines.text: With Muse Wonder, we introduced Active Memory and Active Focus. We’re bringing both of these to our specialized models in Muse and Meta AI.

blocks.text: Active Memory enables Muse and Meta AI to remember what matters and recognize when earlier information becomes relevant, making it easier to build off your past conversations. We’ve trained our models to recognize what type of information is temporary versus permanent, to reason across time, and to distinguish between what is still relevant and what has become stale. For example, our improved models in Muse show a 2.4x reduction in forgetting critical information necessary for helping you achieve your goals.

blocks.text: Active Focus enables Muse to continue working toward a goal, even when faced with unexpected challenges. We’ve trained our models on a variety of bottlenecks reflective of the real world, so that they can try harder, recover, or find alternatives on your behalf. In Muse, our models show a 67% improvement in completing everyday tasks where unexpected issues arise.

blocks.text: We’ve also developed our specialized models to leverage Muse Wonder’s performance on behaviors that are especially important to Muse. For example, they learned to be excellent multi-taskers that know when to push on your goals independently or collaborate live with you. They can also better adapt to steers and clarifications in the middle of running tasks without getting confused.

blocks.text: In Meta AI, the same improvements make for a better thinking partner and collaborator. It can break complex problems into clear steps, ask sharper follow-up questions, and keep up when you change direction mid-conversation.
